Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; curated Effect/Ability IDs, never inferred from prose.

Cards.Name: Daigotsu Susaiken
Cards.Text:
After Susaiken enters play: Discard all your other Sensei Personalities.
Once per turn, you may refill one of your provinces face-up.

Cards.Name: Kitsune Haruki
Cards.Text: Reaction: After Haruki enters play: Create a 2F/2C/3PH Mantis Clan • Nonhuman • Deer • Spirit Personality with the ability, "Limited: If another player has higher Family Honor than you: Gain 2 Honor."

Cards.Name: Shosuro Ietsuno
Cards.Text:
After a card from a deck refills Ietsuno's battlefield's province: Look at it. You may switch it with a card owned by the same player in another province.
Battle: Target an enemy card without attachments: Bow it.

Cards.Name: Kuni Renyu
Cards.Text:
After an action targets Renyu: Reduce any Honor losses from its effects to 0.
Battle: Target an enemy unit: Its controller may choose to bow it and destroy all Shadowlands cards in it. If he did not choose this, create a province with a base strength of 4 to the left of your leftmost province.

Cards.Name: Otomo Suikihime
Cards.Text:
You may not assign, and will not move, Suikihime to battlefields. Suikihime will not become dishonorable. Other players' Political actions may not target Suikihime.
Reaction: Once per game, after Suikihime enters play, if no other player controls The Forgotten Temple: Suikihime grants you new lands in the Colonies. Gain a province to the left of your leftmost province. After the next time this game Suikihime leaves play, destroy your leftmost province.
